Question: Assalamu Alaikum my quesion is to kindly clear me in detail with full refrence of Quran and Hadith the difference between salah postures of namaz between male and female as I am from hanafi maslak and my friends are telling me that I am not performing it according to as mentioned in Hadith.So I need a detailed answer in english or in urdu language? Answer ID: 11049 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 273/273=M/1430) For this, you should study Namaz-e-Ahnaf written by Mufti Habibur Rahman Qasmi Allahabdi. This book consists of evidences from the Quran, Hadith and traditions of Sahaba in detail. It has been published from Maktaba Rahmania, Azampur, Mau Aimah, Allahabad UP and is available on Deoband book depots. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
